elder_dead.name: Elder Dead
elder_dead.blurb: The dead rise 3 levels older per step.

iron_dead.name: Iron Dead
iron_dead.blurb: Enemies have 25% more health per step.

frail_vessel.name: Frail Vessel
frail_vessel.blurb: You have 12% less maximum health per step.

famished.name: Famished Rites
famished.blurb: Grave Essence returns 20% slower per step.

brittle_thralls.name: Brittle Dead
brittle_thralls.blurb: Your thralls have 20% less health per step.

swollen_waves.name: Swollen Waves
swollen_waves.blurb: Every wave brings 25% more of the dead per step.

dry_cellar.name: Dry Cellar
dry_cellar.blurb: Healing flasks no longer work for you (brews and meals still do).

elite_surge.name: Bloodied Elites
elite_surge.blurb: Elites are 8% more common per step.

deacon_host.name: Deacon Host
deacon_host.blurb: Crypt Deacons are twice as common (step 2: three times).

prelate_echo.name: Prelate Echoes
prelate_echo.blurb: The Prelate learns a new trick per step: a second bell, an elite procession, chasing rain.

first_rites.name: First Rites
first_rites.blurb: Begin each run with 2 Damage tiers already bought.

shard_keeper.name: Shard Keeper
shard_keeper.blurb: Never begin a run holding fewer than 2 soul shards.

swift_seals.name: Swift Seals
swift_seals.blurb: Sealed doors not yet opened need 20% fewer kills.

grave_feast.name: Grave Feast
grave_feast.blurb: Every corpse you consume heals you for 3% of your maximum health.

bonded_dead.name: Bonded Dead
bonded_dead.blurb: A thrall rises beside you whenever you enter a hunting ground with none.

hollow_sacrifice.name: Hollow Sacrifice
hollow_sacrifice.blurb: A thrall you sacrifice leaves a fresh corpse behind.

bone_ward.name: Bone Ward
bone_ward.blurb: Each thrall standing beside you turns away 2% more of the damage you take.

carrion_bloom.name: Carrion Bloom
carrion_bloom.blurb: Corpses caught inside your Miasma burst.
